title: Gym & Studio Payment Processing Fees Explained (2026)
description: How gym and studio software charges for payments: Stripe pass-through, platform %, bundled rates, monthly fees, surcharging, with a $10,000/mo example.
h1: Gym and studio software payment processing fees, explained
body:
What a gym or studio pays to collect tuition is often bigger than its software subscription. Every app on this site charges for payments in one of six ways: a straight pass-through of Stripe's price, a platform percentage on top, its own bundled rate, a monthly processing fee, a cheaper subscription if you use their processor, or a fee the member pays. This guide explains each model with the rates vendors publish, then runs the same $10,000 month through them.

We checked each vendor's own pricing, payments and terms pages on November 21, 2026. We haven't used these products ourselves and we don't publish ratings. If a vendor doesn't publish a number, we say unknown. For martial-arts-only detail, see martial arts billing software: processing fees compared.

The baseline: Stripe's standard price

Many studio apps run on Stripe, so its public US price is the yardstick: 2.9% + 30¢ per successful domestic card payment, plus 0.5% for manually entered cards, 1.5% for international cards and 1% if currency conversion is needed. ACH Direct Debit is 0.8%, capped at $5.00. No setup or monthly fees (Stripe pricing). On a $100 tuition payment that's $3.20 by card and $0.80 by ACH. Moving families to ACH is usually the biggest single saving.

The six fee models

1. Stripe pass-through, no markup

  • Martialytics: standard Stripe rates, no markup and no revenue percentage, per the vendor (pricing).
  • Dojo Champ: standard Stripe fees (it quotes 2.9% + $0.30 card, 0.8% ACH capped at $5), no Dojo Champ platform fee (pricing).
  • MatGoat: no setup fee and no percentage on student payments; Stripe's own fees apply. Payment management is on Professional ($60/mo) only (pricing).
  • Mariana Tek: Stripe's standard flat rate for every card type, nothing added on top. The exact rate isn't stated on its page (pricing FAQ).

2. A platform percentage on top of Stripe

  • MAAT: +1% transaction fee, excluding Stripe fees ($49/mo paid annually or $59/mo) (pricing).
  • MatPilot: 2% on payments taken through MatPilot on Free ($0/mo); Pro ($79/mo) drops it to 0.49%. Stripe's fee applies on both (pricing).
  • MASS: 2% platform fee on all student membership payments processed through the platform, deducted via Stripe (Terms of Service 3.7, version 2026-11-06) (terms).
  • Arketa Individual ($49/mo billed annually): 3% transaction fee + Stripe fees (pricing).
  • Studio Pro: only if you bring a third-party processor, a 1.35% tech fee per transaction on top of that processor's fee (payment processing).
  • MakeMusic Studio (formerly Fons): 2.9% + $0.30 per card charge (+1% international), 1.8% per ACH charge, and 0.4% of subscription volume (pricing).

3. The vendor's own bundled rate

  • PushPress: the rate depends on the plan. Free ($0/mo): 4.99% + $0.30 card, 2.89% + $0.30 ACH. Pro ($159/mo): 2.89% + $0.30 card, 0.79% + $0.30 ACH. Max ($229/mo): 2.75% + $0.30 card, 0.79% + $0.30 ACH (pricing).
  • Studio Pro Merchant Services: from 2.66% + $0.25 for US merchants (same page as above).
  • Virtuagym: card-not-present Visa and Mastercard payments 2.75% + .20 per transaction; volume discounts on request (prices).
  • Wodify Payments: cards as low as 2.7% + 30¢, ACH as low as 1.5% + 30¢, no monthly processing fee; rates vary by plan and country, and Ultimate lists "our lowest processing rates" (pricing FAQ).
  • Mindbody Payments: a processing rate that varies by card-present vs card-not-present and payment type, plus a fixed $0.10-$0.30 per transaction (North America and Asia). The percentage itself isn't published (pricing FAQ).

4. A monthly processing fee

  • Kicksite (US, through Basys): card-only $29/month plus 2.9% + $0.25 per transaction. Card + ACH: $35 setup, $49/month, 2.9% + $0.25 per card and $0.30 per ACH transaction (payment processing).

5. A cheaper subscription if you use their processor

  • Gymdesk: every tier is $25/mo less with Gymdesk Payments (e.g. $75 vs $100/mo up to 50 active members). The Gymdesk Payments rate: unknown (pricing).
  • The Studio Director: Software + Payments costs less than Software Only at every size, e.g. $39 vs $65/mo for 0-100 students and $79 vs $119/mo for 101-250. Processing rate: unknown (pricing).

A discount like this is only a saving if the in-house rate is close to what you'd pay elsewhere. Since neither vendor publishes its rate, ask for it in writing before you choose.

6. The member pays the fee

  • Recess: $0 to the studio; members pay a service fee of about 5% at checkout (pricing).
  • Duet (music teachers): a 1% fee is added to what the family pays by any digital method. Card, Apple Pay and Google Pay payments also carry Stripe's 2.9% processing fee; ACH bank transfers don't (Duet blog).
  • Surcharging tools: Spark Membership offers automatic surcharging, credit only, capped at your actual rate and switched off where it isn't legal, or dual pricing instead (Spark Payments). Studio Pro lets you set a surcharge of up to 3%. Mindbody also offers surcharging where permitted (Mindbody Payments). Surcharge rules differ by state and country, so check yours before turning it on.

Worked example: $10,000 a month in card tuition

Assume 100 domestic card payments of $100 each, entered online (card not present), and published rates only. "Processing" is what leaves your account in fees. Where a plan's price changes the answer, we show it too.

Break-even points worth knowing

  • PushPress Free vs Pro: Pro's card rate is 2.1 points lower, so the $159 plan pays for itself at about $7,571/month in card payments (159 ÷ 0.021). More detail in PushPress vs Gymdesk.
  • MatPilot Free vs Pro: the platform fee drops 1.51 points, so Pro's $79 pays for itself at about $5,232/month through MatPilot.
  • Kicksite's $29/month: compared with Stripe's 2.9% + 30¢, Kicksite saves $0.05 per payment on the fixed part, so its monthly fee only evens out at 580 card payments a month.
  • ACH vs card: on Stripe, a $100 payment costs $0.80 by ACH vs $3.20 by card. If 60 of the 100 families above paid by ACH, Stripe fees would fall from $320 to about $176.

Questions to ask any vendor

  • What is my exact card and ACH rate, and is it flat or does it vary by card type?
  • Is there a monthly processing fee, setup fee, or platform percentage on top?
  • Can I use my own Stripe or processor account, and does the subscription price change if I do?
  • Can I pass fees on (surcharging or dual pricing), and is that legal where I teach?
  • If I leave, can stored cards and autopay move with me? Our software buying checklist covers this.

Compare plan prices by school size in martial arts software pricing, and see what Mindbody charges beyond processing in Mindbody pricing. You can model your own tuition in the membership revenue calculator.

faq: What does Stripe charge a gym or studio for card payments?

In the US, 2.9% + 30¢ per successful domestic card payment, plus 0.5% for manually entered cards, 1.5% for international cards and 1% if currency conversion is needed. ACH Direct Debit is 0.8% capped at $5.00 (stripe.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-21).
Which studio software adds no fee on top of Stripe?
Martialytics, Dojo Champ, MatGoat and Mariana Tek each say they charge standard Stripe rates with nothing added (each vendor's pricing page, checked 2026-11-21).
Which studio software charges a platform percentage?

MAAT adds 1%, MatPilot 2% on Free or 0.49% on Pro, MASS 2% (Terms 3.7) and Arketa's Individual plan 3%, each on top of Stripe's fees. Studio Pro adds a 1.35% tech fee only if you use a third-party processor (vendor pages, checked 2026-11-21).
When is PushPress Pro cheaper than the Free plan?
Pro costs $159/mo and cuts the card rate from 4.99% + $0.30 to 2.89% + $0.30, so it's cheaper once you take about $7,571 a month in card payments (pushpress.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-21).
Can I pass card fees on to members?

Some tools support it: Spark Membership offers automatic credit-card surcharging capped at your actual rate, or dual pricing; Studio Pro allows a surcharge of up to 3%; Mindbody offers surcharging where permitted. Rules vary by location (vendor pages, checked 2026-11-21).
